catalog.name: Your Chrome
catalog.description: Your own browser, on the sites you allow, while you watch.
catalog.hint: For the sites the sandbox's own browser can't reach: your passkeys, your work SSO, your bank. Nothing is copied out of your browser; the agent works in it, and you can see every click.

steps: Add the browser here, then click `Connect` on its card for a one-time code.
Install the Intentic extension in that browser (Chrome, Edge, Brave or Opera) and paste the code into it.
Allow it on one site to start with: the extension asks the browser for that site, and the browser enforces it.
It can only touch sites you allowed, and only while that browser is open. Pause or revoke it from the extension at any time.

catalog.name: Your Edge
catalog.description: Your own Edge, on the sites you allow, while you watch.
catalog.hint: The same connector as Chrome — Edge is Chromium, and the extension is the same one. Worth its own card when Edge is where the work accounts are signed in.

steps: Add the browser here, then click `Connect` on its card for a one-time code.
